verifier: adversarial verifier, integration lane client, verify-only round 2, 2026-10-29. Re-measured at HEAD ac7c4cb0 (= origin). This round re-checks only lead:new-icons. I did not trust the engineer's report.
summary: lead:new-icons passes. Neither refixed icon reads as blood any more. Shadowpin is a pale carved spike standing in a pale grey flagstone, with a violet shadow under the point and no liquid. Lampblack Edge is a pale blue-steel knife with one black fuller and a pale cord grip; there are no red flecks and no smoke curl. Resin Maul is now a smooth, rounded amber lump with no facets, so the cut-gem read is gone. Re-running the engineer's dark-red script on the shipped webps gives the same numbers they reported. icon_probe passes with the same floors as round 1. The refix touched only 3 webps and tools/imagegen. No regression. The 18-item content repoint is still the systems stitch: content/items.json still borrows whetted_knife, glint_sling and banded_club. Round 1 already accepted that as out of lane.

items.evidence:
Checked by eye at 256 px, 512 px nearest and 128/64/40/38 px. Shots: _harness/_shots/integ_client_ver2_old_new_256.png (old row above new), integ_client_ver2_new_2x.png and integ_client_ver2_new_small.png.
(1) shadowpin.webp: a pale carved stone spike stands in a pale grey round flagstone. A crisp violet shadow lies on the flagstone under the point. There is no pool, no liquid, no gloss and no red on the subject.
(2) lampblack_edge.webp: a pale blue-steel knife with one black fuller and a pale grey cord grip. There is no smoke curl and no fleck on the tip.
(3) resin_maul.webp: a smooth, rounded, cloudy amber head with two bands, on a wooden haft. The drip is golden, and there are no flat faces or facets.
The raw r2 paintings (tools/imagegen/raw/item_{shadowpin,lampblack_edge,resin_maul}__r2.png, _harness/_shots/integ_client_ver2_raw_r2.png) match the graded subjects, so the grade added no new dark-red paint.
Dark-red script: python3 _harness/_reports/integ_client_r1_darkred.py on old and new gives _harness/_reports/integ_client_ver2_darkred.txt. Dark-red share of the silhouette: shadowpin 13.4% -> 0.3% (47 px), lampblack_edge 6.7% -> 0.0% (2 px). The fuller's dark mean is rgb(36,41,46), a neutral black.
Independent overlay of L*<28, a*>12, hue -10..45 (_harness/_shots/integ_client_ver2_darkred_L28.png): on shadowpin and lampblack_edge the only hits are the Strike ground vignette and the contact-shadow rim outside each subject. Inside the subject there are none.
node _harness/icon_probe.mjs --out _harness/_reports/integ_client_ver2_icon_probe.json: OK. Items 57, p50 min 66 and p95 min 192 at 38 and 40 px. Abilities 94, navy 0, closest cross-family ground 56 (hourcleaver/dust_runners).

icon_grade.py: override is defaulted to {} at line 206. OVERRIDES applies 'enclosed' and 'fill' only to item_lampblack_edge and item_shadowpin, so no other icon's grade changes.
Watch items, not failures: (a) resin_maul's ironstone bands grade red-brown on the Strike ground, 7.1% of the silhouette. They read as banded rusty stone, not liquid, the same as round 1. (b) lampblack_edge's keyed glow is a blue disc behind the blade on the red ground. It reads as a glow and does not hurt the read at 38 px. (c) At 38 px shadowpin's flagstone dominates and the spike is a thin pale stroke. It still reads (p50 71 / p95 198).
